Container.Name: Talaria
Container.Overview: Talaria: a web app and Telegram bot for Hermes Agent, with a sandbox for the agent's commands and your own computers paired in. One container: hub, agent and sandbox. Open the web UI right after the first start: the first visitor makes the admin account.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address you open Talaria at, such as http://192.168.1.10:8080 (this server's address and the web port) or https://talaria.example.com behind a reverse proxy. Pages and push notifications need HTTPS.

Config.Name: Talaria data
Config.Description: Hub database, keys, and the sandbox's files

Config.Name: Demo model
Config.Description: true: a stand-in model that needs no API key, to try Talaria (pick talaria-demo with: docker exec -it -u hermes Talaria hermes model). The model and provider are Hermes settings, see the docs

Config.Name: Your hub user
Config.Description: Optional: the hub account of the person this agent works for, once it exists. Names that person in memory, and owns chats that are on no computer

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: IANA name, such as America/New_York. Empty: UTC

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner of the Hermes data folder

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group of the Hermes data folder
